The '''''Spotrunner''''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scout ship/Legends|scout ship]]. During an [[Deep Charting Expedition|expedition]] into the depths of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], a [[Mnggal-Mnggal]] outbreak occurred on ''Spotrunner'' which lead to the death of the entire crew.
